notes.title: (Promo) OKJOY's "Cavalry Girls" shooter game is now live!
notes.notes:
Published by OKJOY, the light Rogue mech-girl top-down shooter "Cavalry Girls" is set to officially launch on the Steam platform at 01:00 Pacific Time today (October 20th)! The game has a total playtime of over 20 hours!

Store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055050/_/?utm_source=tonggao&utm_campaign=shoufa

[h3]Game Introduction:[/h3]
Cavalry Girls is a light roguelike top-down shooter indie game. In this game, players will lead Cavalry Girls into battles against enemy forces. Modify various mecha models, strategically deploy mechas with different skills, repel the overwhelming enemies, and defend your empire amid the raging fires. With limited supplies, players will have to make wise resource allocations, manage soldiers and survive on an increasingly intense battlefield.

[h3]Game Featured[/h3]
[b]
Top-Down Shooting[/b]

- Experience the authentic shooting feel and enjoy the thrilling battlefield.
- A plethora of equipment modules to choose from, with each weapon offering distinct effects.
- Engage in rogue-like combat against dozens of enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/da19247ff2bf6466bd226ca5d72d91175477b64a.gif[/img]
[b]
Strategic Deployment[/b]

- Choose your favorite equipment and teammates and pick modules to build the most powerful mecha.
- Gather intelligence for strategic deployment and strike enemies based on their unique characteristics.
- Make decisions using limited resources - take risks or play it safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/82762e0d6f028ec0da94c5d734abab766a52bebb.gif[/img]

[b]Casual Gameplay[/b]

- Five recruitable characters with distinct personalities. Choose your favorite Cavalry Girls to accompany you in battle.
- Arrange cozy dorms for Cavalry Girls and give them gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/a8e869f4ba3bf18ca467dff232593b444f7f7bc5.gif[/img]

notes.title: "Taoism" awaits you at the Steam Strategy Game Festival!
notes.notes:
Dear beloved players,

Our title, "Taoism," is gearing up to be part of the Steam Strategy Game Festival! The event will kick off at 10 a.m. on August 28th and run until 10 a.m. on September 4th. During this period, you can locate our game in the Strategy Game Festival section and indulge in the gameplay alongside fellow strategy game enthusiasts.

For this Strategy Game Festival, we've also released a new DEMO update. Here are the details for this update:
[b]
Update Contents:[/b]

Introduced the Soul Lamp system and Creation system.
Added more cards.
Incorporated more random map events.
Shops now offer creations and discounted items.
Added a character selection page.
Re-optimized enemy difficulty.
Adjusted the design of the reward pool.

[b]New Rule Changes:[/b]

Players can choose not to play any card and end the turn directly. (To prevent mistakes, especially for new players, please do not end the turn without playing a card).
Soul Lamp System Explanation: Failure in non-BOSS battles will result in a -1 Soul Lamp. When it drops to 0, the current game ends. If you lose in a Boss battle, the game also ends immediately.

[b]Save File Issue Explanation:[/b]

In very rare cases, you may not be able to start the game after entering the game or selecting a character due to a conflict between old and new save files.
 To resolve this, navigate to C:\Users[Username]\AppData\LocalLow\Tiramihu\FloatingLifeFantasia and delete the SaveFile.save document. Re-enter the game to resolve the issue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/50f35d41d16fb91a1bc8b888292cc1c49422474a.png[/img]

"Taoism" blends profoundly with Chinese-style folklore themes, offering you an alternative Roguelike deck-building game steeped in mystery. The game's unique "Yin-Yang Opposition" and "Pure Yang Overflow" mechanics will ensure a thrilling experience where fortunes can change with every turn.

On the mist-shrouded lands of Luo'nan Kingdom, you'll engage with a variety of characters, face off against Taoist priests and spectral apparitions, and constantly collect and wield new card decks. Every step is filled with the unknown, and every game might unveil secrets behind Luo'nan's decline.

For all strategy game enthusiasts out there, don't miss out on this event. We eagerly anticipate meeting you during the Steam Strategy Game Festival.

Thank you all for the enduring support and love for our game. We wish you enjoyable gameplay!

notes.title: OKJOY brings diverse gaming to the Chinajoy x Game Connection event!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! OKJOY will participate in the Chinajoy x Game Connection event on July 26th, bringing along our games "HAAK", "Moolii's Dreamland", "The Heroes Around Me", "Taoism", "The Road of Gaokao", and "Avici".

We offer a diverse range of games to meet the needs of all gaming enthusiasts. Whether you're a fan of adventure games, puzzle games, or strategy games, you can find your niche in the games listed below. Now, start with the game descriptions and links below, choose the game you're interested in, and dive into an exciting demo play experience right away!

HAAK：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352930/HAAK/
Intro：HAAK is a Metroidvania-Platformer. As the mysterious wanderer Haak, you embarked on an epic expedition across the vast cyber-wasteland to find your lost brother. Explore deserted cities and metro, refine your weapons and hack skills, and uncover the secrets behind metal and dust.

Moolii's Dreamland：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280380/Mooliis_Dreamland/
Intro：Help Moolii on her nightmare of the forest! Use claws and bullets and dodge in the roguelite bullet-hell where all Moolii's cuttie friends become Mobs and Bosses! Collect and upgrade bullets to help Moolii!

The Heroes Around Me：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1768470/The_Heroes_Around_Me/
Intro：The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s, where lots of stories are untold.

Taoism：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331080/Taoism/
Intro：Taoism is a rougelike card game inspired by Chinese mythical tales. When evil spirits are all over the space, you’ll explore the mysterious country Luo Nan, use different cards to defeat Taoist priests as well as evil spirits and find the truth of the decline of Luo Nan.

The Road of Gaokao：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1705420/_/
Intro："The Road of Gaokao" is a unique Roguelike card game where you will face a Gaokao countdown of just 100 days. A hundred days of sprinting, a hundred days of change. From study to routine, from diet to exercise, from emotion control to test-taking strategy, meticulously plan and fortify step by step, give it your all, and optimize your preparation plan.

Avici：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050520/Avici/
Intro：Use the daytime to search for treasures, trade with hermits, and investigate the strange experiences of former expedition members; Or with limited oxygen and lighting equipment, dive deep into the endless darkness of the seabed, escape the threat of unknown creatures, and seek powerful technology.

notes.title: 浮生九还 X 《夺玦》桌游|角色联动卡牌正式推出！
notes.notes:
武侠区控卡牌桌游遇上国风志怪卡牌游戏会有怎样的火花呢？
Roguelike卡牌游戏《浮生九还》正式与武侠区控桌游《夺玦》系列开启角色联动，《浮生九还》中的“元兮”和“章遵”两位角色将加入《夺玦》三部曲之二——《夺玦·承瑕》牌库中，成为重要的两张角色牌。
非常荣幸能和《夺玦》进行异业联动，期待卡牌游戏能更加受到更多人喜爱！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/27e43076add1ed2c237277ab5852fc15986bc884.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/314c7341712be9e758a9f1ab70bc3fe2e947e31c.png[/img]

关于《夺玦·承瑕》：
《夺玦》是一款近武侠风双人对战卡牌游戏。玩家将扮演心怀壮志的诸侯，招募江湖中的各色势力和能人异士，潜人宫廷夺取天子之玦，从而迈出自己千秋霸业的第一步。
《夺玦·承瑕》是《夺玦》的首个正式扩展包。在《夺玦·承瑕》中，玩家所扮演的诸侯对抗重心将从一宫一室之内转向广阔的战场，在滚滚狼烟与猎猎旌旗之下一决胜负。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/b4d394e00b37d18ab6237cfeebd5d1e6863a4353.png[/img]

近期《夺玦·承瑕》桌游已在摩点开启众筹，感兴趣的玩家可以前往购买支持：https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/124653.html

游戏介绍：
《浮生九还》是一款国风志怪题材的另类Roguelike卡牌构筑游戏，拥有独创的八卦阴阳相冲、同阳充盈玩法及规则，每个回合都随时有扭转乾坤的可能。
乱世间异鬼横行，玩家将探索迷雾重重的洛南国，亲历不同角色，在一次次和道士、异鬼的交手中，收集和使用不同类型的卡组，逐渐揭开角色本身的故事和洛南国衰落的真相。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/b4d6ce5fc12b8fcb36853e9494c5032dbb4c93d7.png[/img]

Steam商店页：
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331080/_/

非常开心能和《夺玦》这样优秀的桌游进行合作，期待后续能一同创造更多好的作品！大家平时日常喜欢玩桌游吗，会期待《浮生九还》和桌游玩法的更多联动吗？

notes.title: Taoism Demo Update Announcement - 20230625
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The demo of "Taoism" will be updated on June 25, 2023. We have optimized a series of game elements and fixed some known bugs. Below are the specific contents of this update:

Fixed a bug after playing the Qin Dream Bell, if only the Three Soul Strings are left and there are no own cards on the field, the turn cannot end.
Fixed a bug where some cards trigger their abilities while in hand.
Fixed a bug where the Three Soul Strings (Battle Formation Skill) cannot be played.
Fixed a bug where the Examination Cage cannot play cards drawn additionally in the current round.
Fixed a bug where fast clicking on the map node causes consecutive triggering of map events.
Fixed a bug Restore health before entering the boss node in the map.
Optimization: Speed of some battle animations.
Optimization: After the victory, you can continue the game from the current save slot.
Optimization: After SL from the current node, continue from the previous node.
Optimization: New collision and enhancement special effects and sound effects.
Optimization of illusion formation skill trigger timing and activation prompts.
AI optimization: Reduce the probability of Ghost Pan taking effect on the troubled ground.
AI optimization: Will not choose to collide or enhance with the player in the first round.
Adjustments to some ability descriptions.

notes.title: Chinese-style folklore-themed card game 'Taoism‘ now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Published by OKJOY and developed by Tiramihoo, the unique Chinese bizarre folklore-themed Roguelike card game ‘Taoism’ is now officially available on the Steam store page!

[b]-->>Link to Steam store page: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331080/_/

In the game, you will take on the roles of various characters, using the cards transformed from faith to explore the mysterious and fog-shrouded country of Luonan. Skillfully utilize unique rules to uncover a massive conspiracy involving humans, Daoists, and ghosts. Unravel the karmic entanglements of these characters, gradually unveil the hidden past and secrets buried beneath Yun'an City for ten years, and together explore the truth concealed beneath the undercurrents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956970/c240e837bc77acb43eaf947a53348a54806ea6c1.png[/img]

[b]>>Game Introduction<<[/b]
The country of Luonan was built along the Luoshui River and flourished for over a hundred years. However, in the ten years since the Yun'an Incident, Luonan has become a battlefield rife with conspiracy and desire. Ghosts devour humans, and so do Daoists. People often say, "Wearing armor brings glory, but a Daoist robe is more esteemed." Ghosts and temples have made survival even more challenging for the people, but they firmly believe that one day they will see the light again.

[b]Unique card-playing method[/b]
- Card battlefield in the form of Eight Diagrams: the original round card field "Hunyuan plate", feeling the thrilling strategic sense brought by the two core rules "competing/competing".
- Two types of cards for each faction: Hunyuan cards with different abilities, and Qixiang cards with powerful functions, or skillfully combine the two to instantly defeat the enemy invisibly.
- The ever-changing battlefield situation: the unique mechanism "Huayuan" can help you turn the world around when you are in adversity, and the enemy may have thought of this.

[b]Rich play content[/b]
- Mysterious and unpredictable different enemies: defeat the elite monster and even the more powerful BOSS, deal with their powerful array of cards and spells, and fight a bloody way.
- Powerful help of the road of adventure: gain gains from many random events, and trade in stores to exchange for more cards or powerful items.
- Discover the story behind the cards: Each token card constitutes the story fragment of the protagonist, and collect cards to discover more unknown secrets.

[b]Map to be explored[/b]
- Luonan, shrouded in the mist: explore freely and move towards the truth in this once rich and now undercurrent country.
- Randomly generated exploration points: each game can randomly generate new exploration points, and the road of adventure is full of magic and unknown.
- Hidden places in some corners: in some specific areas, some unique creations or stories may be encountered.
